summary: In the most recent reporting period, Boise State University experienced a notable increase in incidents involving alcohol violations, particularly concentrated in the Towers and Barnes Towers locations, where multiple referrals to the Dean of Students were made. Additionally, a hit-and-run incident was reported during a protest, marking a concerning trend in vehicular-related offenses. Comparatively, incidents of DUI and reckless driving appear to have stabilized, with several cases closed by arrest, indicating effective enforcement. The overall pattern suggests a heightened focus on alcohol-related issues, while other categories of crime remain relatively consistent with previous months.
